docs.summary: Indicates that a type's structure is fixed and will not change, allowing for more efficient ordinal-based serialization. This doesn't require that memory layout is fixed, only that the order of fields is fixed. This works great for types like Vector3, Quaternion, etc. Since those types are always the same size and layout. It also works great for network packets and other fixed-size structures, where you know the Writer and Reader will always be in sync. This is highly recommended to be used when possible.
